entries.en: He's having a "nervous breakdown?" Going through a "tough time?" Did I ask you for a fucking psych eval?
entries.ro: Are o „cădere nervoasă”? Trece printr-o „perioadă grea”? Ți-am cerut eu vreo evaluare psihologică de căcat?

entries.en: OK, the guy's got issues, but he deserves a second chance. We can help him out.
entries.ro: OK, tipul are probleme, dar merită o a doua șansă. Putem să-l ajutăm.

entries.en: Issues? He's the fucking issue! Singular!
entries.ro: Probleme? El e problema aia nenorocită! La singular!
